query: INSERT INTO organization_settings (id, time_zone, fiscal_year_start_month, stalled_after_days, set_by) VALUES (1, $1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET time_zone = EXCLUDED.time_zone, fiscal_year_start_month = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year_start_month, stalled_after_days = EXCLUDED.stalled_after_days, set_by = EXCLUDED.set_by, updated_at = now()
